SEBI Proposes Changes to Mutual Fund Settlement Processes

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has proposed a new framework for the net settlement of mutual fund transactions in the cash market. This proposal aims to streamline the settlement process for mutual funds. The specific details of the proposed changes and their potential impact on investors and the market are currently under discussion. SEBI is seeking feedback on the proposal before finalizing any new regulations.
